name: Airepoto
description:
Airepoto connects Claude to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Airepoto to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Airepoto to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://svcsmcp.airepoto.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Airepoto MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airepoto lists 14 MCP tools, including airepoto_create_minutes, airepoto_delete_minutes, airepoto_get_group_settings, airepoto_get_minutes, airepoto_get_script, airepoto_get_summary, airepoto_list_companies, airepoto_list_groups, airepoto_list_members, airepoto_list_minutes, airepoto_prepare_upload, and airepoto_request_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Airepoto?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Airepoto in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Airepoto requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Airepoto is developed by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
